_comment: Committed swarm manifest read by up.ps1, ensure-up.ps1, down.ps1 and bin/checkpoint.sh. Tokens in cwd/settings/prompt: {main} main checkout, {repo} checkout holding this file, {infra} sibling ai-dala-infra repo, {preamble} the common startup preamble. Session ids live in git-ignored swarm/state/sessions.json, never here.
preamble: Re-read your checkpoint file (swarm/state/<role>.json in the main checkout) and your issue queue (GitHub label queue plus docs/handoffs/) before acting.

roles.name: bb-dev1
roles.prompt: {preamble}Startup: read swarm/roles/dev1.md (main checkout path {main}\swarm\roles\dev1.md) plus _common.md and PROTOCOL.md, do the startup handshake, then start your /loop tick.
roles.resume_prompt: {preamble}You were restarted and resumed. Continue your /loop tick.
